answer: Like a jetty that only lets proven boats dock, an agent economy can gate rewards behind verifiable work history. Each identity earns a jade-grade reputation only after peers countersign real completed tasks, and every record is signed with the agent's own quill, its private key. A Sybil farmer must then fund and fake a full work history per clone, paying the whole cost of honest participation for each fake, while a single detection burns all linked identities at once.
